purpose: Calibrate a NEW combined corroboration signal for the 24 sub-0.05 MIP hints: title-hit (a distinctive >=8-char substring of the doc's own title found verbatim in the matched MIP's raw text) AND a nonzero content-containment score in that SAME mip. Gate 4 rejected title-hit ALONE (1/8 wrong-MIP case); this asks whether requiring BOTH signals to agree on the same MIP is safe to auto-lock.
method: FULL POPULATION review, not a sample: exactly 8 genesis-bridged docs in the entire corpus have both title-hit=true and 0 < mipScore < 0.05 in the same MIP (this is the complete set, not a stratified subset) — reviewed each with real side-by-side genesis-vs-MIP-section text, labeled by Claude (Fable 5) with per-item rationale, same TRUE/PARTIAL/FALSE definitions as gate4-mip-calibration.json.
labelDefinition: TRUE = same provision/rule recognizably descending from the matched MIP section (verbatim, paraphrase, or Maker->Sky rebrand); PARTIAL = real process/template lineage but provision-level claim arguable; FALSE = coincidental/boilerplate/wrong section
interpretation: The Wilson interval is wide because n=8 is small — but n=8 is not a SAMPLE of a larger unreviewed population, it is the ENTIRE population this rule would ever affect (every genesis-bridged doc with this exact signal combination has been checked, not extrapolated from). Zero FALSE and zero wrong-MIP cases is the key finding: pure title-hit-alone (Gate 4) had 1/8 wrong-MIP; requiring content agreement in the SAME mip as the title-hit appears to filter exactly that failure mode, at the cost of only one arguable PARTIAL (scope broadened, not misattributed).

decision.newRule: Auto-lock when titleHit is true AND mipScore > 0 in that SAME mip (previously: mipScore alone had to be >= 0.05; title-hit alone never locked per Gate 4). Docs with titleHit pointing at a DIFFERENT mip than the best content score still do not lock (unreviewed combination, not covered by this calibration).
decision.effect: 8 additional MIP-traceable docs (of the 24 sub-threshold hints); 16 sub-threshold hints remain unpromoted (no title-hit, or title-hit disagrees with best-content mip)
decision.caveat: 1 PARTIAL (Whistleblower Bounty) ships with the same lineage claim as the 7 TRUE cases — the auto-lock event doesn't distinguish PARTIAL from TRUE (no mechanism for that gradation exists), consistent with how Gate 4's own template-boilerplate PARTIAL (X11) already ships without a distinguishing marker.
